stages.when: After S1 and S2 are both processed, before the withdrawal.

anchor.quote: Zamówiłem u Ceramica Nova gres na Modlińską

memoryChanges.rationale: Supplier named in the order message (sole source for this detail).
Two bosses, two independent conversations: the quantity has two sources.

prohibitedWrites.mustNot: Split the quantity into two findings because two people stated it.

memoryChanges.historyExpectation: S1's earlier role and the withdrawal reason stay in history.
memoryChanges.rationale: The supplier name existed only in the withdrawn S1; with its sole support gone the finding must be re-evaluated to unknown.

memoryChanges.historyExpectation: S1's support link is removed with the withdrawal; S2's independent confirmation keeps its role.
memoryChanges.rationale: A withdrawn source cannot solely support current information — but the 90 m² fact survives on S2's independent support.

prohibitedWrites.mustNot: Keep 'Ceramica Nova' as the current supplier.
prohibitedWrites.because: Its only support was withdrawn; presenting it as established has no source basis.

prohibitedWrites.mustNot: Drop the 90 m² quantity together with the withdrawal.
prohibitedWrites.because: Independent corroboration survives the withdrawal of the other source.

prohibitedWrites.mustNot: Withdraw S2 or mark it suspicious.
prohibitedWrites.because: S2 is an independent, untouched source.
